packageRules.description: Automerge minor & patch updates (dependencies AND devDependencies).
Never automerge major updates — they need human validation.
astro/@astrojs/cloudflare are EXACT-PINNED: they need manual PRs — verify `astro dev` locally before merging (CI only builds, so a dev-only break would merge green).

astro 7.2.x breaks `astro dev`: the Cloudflare worker crashes on first SSR render (missing deps_ssr file in vite optimizeDeps, dev process dies). Verified locally on 7.2.0 and 7.2.2 — main/7.1.6 works fine. Re-evaluate when 7.3.0 is out.
@astrojs/cloudflare 14.2.x breaks `astro dev` (same SSR crash as astro 7.2.x — verified locally on 14.2.0 and 14.2.1). Re-evaluate when 14.3.0 is out.
typescript 7.x is the new native compiler — NOT yet supported by the Astro/Volar toolchain (@astrojs/check peerDependencies: ^5 || ^6). Never propose it.
